description.value:
Trigger A creature touches or attempts to activate one of the consoles in the engineering module

Effect Purple electricity crackles across the screens and keyboards of all the consoles. A jolt arcs to one random creature within 10 feet of a console, dealing @Damage[(2d8+5)[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save). The hazard rolls initiative.

details.description: Surging electricity from the damaged power core has charged the consoles in this module with magical electricity, which arcs toward any creature that gets too close to the core.
details.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) or @Check[Physical Science Lore|dc:18] (trained) to safely ground the electricity, @Check[arcana|dc:22] (trained) or Occultism (trained) to redirect the magical component of the electricity, or @Check[crafting|dc:25] to improvise equipment to safely manipulate the console; three total successes are needed to disable the hazard

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path

details.reset: The fluctuating power core recharges the electricity surging through the consoles after 1 minute, after which the hazard can trigger again. Repairing the power core permanently disables the hazard.
details.routine: (2 actions) The surging electricity arcs from the consoles to up to two creatures within 10 feet, dealing @Damage[(2d8+5)[electricity]] damage to each (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic] save).
